title: Benchmarking Algorithmic Bias in Face Recognition: An Experimental Approach Using Synthetic Faces and Human Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking algorithmic bias in face recognition systems concerning demographic attributes (race, gender, age). While this topic falls under the broader umbrella of AI ethics and fairness, it specifically measures performance disparities of AI models rather than evaluating or benchmarking general religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or systems of thought. It addresses a technical aspect of fairness in AI, not a broader philosophical or societal evaluation of ethics or faith.
